paragraphs.source_en: But he also knew three things that scared him no end:

units.source_en: But he also knew three things that scared him no end:

paragraphs.source_en: - His wife believed in the proverbial “free lunch.” That is, she was always open to come-ons. Free cell phones were an example. Every time their cell phone contract expired, the provider offered a “free” cell phone which she proudly grabbed. Somehow she seemed to miss the two year contract it locked them into, over and over again. While small potatoes, it was a bad sign. - The world is filled with predators looking for people precisely like her. - Money and this belief in the “free lunch” attracts them like sharks to bloody chum.
